messages:
leo: Seeing duplicated downstream effects from the onboarding sample during bursts where token refresh + 429 collide. Repro'd locally.
maya: Can you confirm whether the SDK replay happens before or after the auth refresh completes?
leo: it retries after refresh; effectively we resend the identical body and no idempotency header is present so server treats it as new.
jin: quick wins: (1) update sample to demonstrate Idempotency-Key usage, (2) add an optional small replay header (x-rw-replay-id + x-rw-replay) on retries for servers that want to dedupe.
maya: also propose a client config `safeReplayWindowMs` default 3000ms so long-tailed refresh won't blindly replay non-idempotent ops. Document tradeoffs in README.
leo: agree. add telemetry event `sdk.replay_attempt` (replay_id + reason enum) so ops can spot spikes without payloads.
jin: tests: integration that forces token expiry mid-flight and asserts single downstream delivery. unit test for header emission.
ops-bot: Created issue #3701 - onboarding sample: idempotency + opt-in replay headers (leo).
leo: I'll open a small PR with the sample change + docs and ping for reviews.
maya: thx — great small DX improvement.
